__doc__: OpenCode 1.x's `websearch` tool, read STATICALLY (no run, no model) from the compiled opencode-ai 1.18.13 linux-x64 binary (a local install; `strings` over the Bun bundle), 2026-10-17. The 1.18.32 wire capture (agent-tool-schemas-2026-09-27.json) does not advertise it: the registry adds it only for the `opencode` provider or with OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA / OPENCODE_ENABLE_PARALLEL (or OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL) set. Pins OPENCODE_GATE_SURFACE.net.websearch in arbiter/policy/tool-gate-surface.ts. OpenCode 2.0.23 advertises it by default (opencode2-tool-surface-2026-10-05.json).

excerpts.hosts: r0="https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp",O2="https://search.parallel.ai/mcp"; the provider is OPENCODE_WEBSEARCH_PROVIDER, else the enabled one, else picked by a hash of the session id
